app._note: sMApp is a web app. There is NO App Store or Google Play listing for it. Do not add store buttons here: the 'SoilMapp' listed in both stores is CSIRO's unrelated Australian soil survey app (Apple id578173447, package au.csiro.soilmapp), and searching the stores by name leads there. Never link an APK mirror. Verify any future listing by Apple app ID and Android package name, not by app name.
app.what: Count what you see through the microscope, type the numbers in, and sMApp returns bacterial and fungal biomass, the fungal to bacterial ratio, and protozoa and nematode numbers. It builds the same report a Soil Food Web laboratory sends back on a posted sample.

install.lede: sMApp runs in a browser, so there is nothing to install from an app store. Adding it to your home screen gives you an icon that opens sMApp directly.

platforms.name: iPhone and iPad
steps: Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.

platforms.name: Android
steps: Tap the menu button, the three dots.
Choose Add to Home screen. Some phones say Install app.

app.source: What sMApp does, the 400x microscope, the student only accounts and the free to use line were given by the Foundation, 12 September 2026. sMApp has no App Store or Google Play listing, checked 11 September 2026.
app.detail: Work is organised as portfolios, clients and projects, so one practitioner can follow many sites over the years. It needs a microscope that reaches about 400x. A phone camera will not do it. None of the data you enter is kept by Soil Food Web.

access.note: Open release is planned but undated. When it happens, drop 'Accounts are for enrolled students for now' from the free line. Confirm the wording with whoever runs soilmapp.com before it goes out.

app.limit: Accounts are for enrolled students for now.

workWithUs.lede: Whether you’re a farmer looking to implement the soil food web approach to cut back on synthetic inputs and build your natural soil fertility, a landowner looking to restore biodiversity and remediate contamination, or a school system wanting to incorporate our methodology into your curriculum, we welcome you to reach out to us.

cards.title: Farm with biology
cards.body: Cut back on synthetic inputs and build your natural soil fertility. We’ll connect you with our team and trained practitioners to plan, implement, and monitor the transition on your operation.
